title: Traffic Snapshot
description: Per-step state of every traffic light and lane in the simulation. Sent from Simulation Manager to model services on every /predict call.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the active simulation session, set on /reset

step.description: Simulation step counter (0 at start of session)

timestamp_ms.description: Wall-clock time when the Manager captured this snapshot

intersections.description: Map of TLS id → intersection state

lanes.description: Map of lane id → lane state

vehicles.description: Optional. Models that need per-vehicle data may opt in via /info; Manager only sends this if the active model declared it.

phase_index.description: Index into this TLS's program phases

phase_state.description: SUMO phase string (e.g. 'GGrrGGrr'). Lowercase 'g' = priority green, 'G' = green, 'r' = red, 'y' = yellow, 'u' = red-yellow.

time_in_phase.description: Seconds spent in the current phase

time_to_switch.description: Seconds until next scheduled switch. Negative if past scheduled switch time.

controlled_lanes.description: Lane IDs controlled by this TLS

queue_length.description: Halting vehicle count (speed below 0.1 m/s) — getLastStepHaltingNumber

occupancy.description: Fraction of lane length covered by vehicles

avg_speed.description: Mean speed in m/s. NOTE: SUMO returns the lane speed limit when the lane is empty — consumers must filter by vehicle_count > 0 before averaging.

halting_number.description: Alias for queue_length, kept for backwards compatibility
